heading: FlyEM male CNS data
body:
Male CNS connectome project: FlyEM (HHMI Janelia Research Campus), University of Cambridge Department of Zoology, MRC Laboratory of Molecular Biology, and Google Research.

Source: https://male-cns.janelia.org/
Downloads: https://male-cns.janelia.org/download/
Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Legal terms: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode

Modified for flies: neuronal annotations and synaptic connections are filtered, mapped to simulation indices, packed and compressed. Anatomy annotations, positions, eye-column mappings and nervous-system shapes are transformed, simplified or repacked for display. The simulation and anatomical drawings are adaptations, not the original dataset; the creators do not endorse this app.

heading: Scientific model
body:
Shiu, P. K. et al. A Drosophila computational brain model reveals sensorimotor processing. Nature 634, 210–219 (2024). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-024-07763-9

The leaky integrate-and-fire model follows this work; flies implements its own simulation on the male CNS wiring. This is a scientific citation, not a claim to redistribute the paper or its software. Simplified senses, physics, visual background and a body flight reflex stand in for missing biology; the brain chooses through those senses. See About and packages/brain/README.md for limits.

heading: Fonts and Apple Weather
body:
No font files are bundled or downloaded. The app uses fonts already available on your device and system fallbacks.

Where WeatherKit is enabled on Apple TV, weather comes from Apple Weather. Conditions are transformed into the game’s weather and lighting. The service’s current legal attribution and data-source URL appear in About when supplied by WeatherKit. No Apple weather data is bundled. https://weatherkit.apple.com/legal-attribution.html
